relation_to_g0: G0 (PRODUCTION_GATE_MATRIX.json) is unchanged and remains the research gate for a new fast lane. This matrix judges release readiness of the scoped package with protected RODAS5P as default. Neither gate implies the other.
verdict_basis: Plan-stage audit of 2026-11-16; axes are judged with receipts in node V01_AUDIT_RGATE.

axes.criterion: Order, stiff convergence and agreement with independent references for every exposed method on a stratified battery.
Typed failures, no silent fallback, session ownership, non-finite input and step-size underflow handling.
One documented entry point, consistent options and solution view, capability and refusal semantics, MSRV and feature policy.
Clean-checkout build on the pinned toolchain, locked dependencies, deterministic tests, CI evidence on the judged head, independent rerun.
Matched-achieved-error work-precision against external solvers per regime; documented, not required to win.
Workspace membership, separation of research code from the production crates, licences, crate metadata.
Ledger continuity, no evaluation without executed solver output, pre-registration before runs.
2D, 3D and sphere operators with stated limits and executed convergence and conservation contracts.

promotion_rule: Every axis needs an executed receipt on the judged head and an independent rerun. A release remains a separate owner decision.
